info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Mica Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Mica Produce Details Management API enables businesses to create and manage detailed records of mica products within the catalog. This API supports the entry of essential information about mica produce, ensuring that data is consistently captured and stored. Typical consumers include inventory managers and product development teams who need to maintain accurate product specifications. By facilitating streamlined data entry, this API enhances operational efficiency and supports effective decision-making regarding mica inventory.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for mica produce by submitting the required information in the request body. Ensure all necessary fields are filled out correctly to successfully log the details.

requestBody.description: Request payload containing details for Mica produce operations. This object must comply with the specified schema to ensure correct processing and validation.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and the details are returned.

CreateCatalogMicaProduceDetailRequest.title: Mica Produce Details Request

mica_produce_id.description: The unique identifier for the mica produce.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the mica produce.

quantity.description: The quantity of mica produce being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is of high priority.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of the mica produce.

CreateCatalogMicaProduceDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating a mica produce detail operation.

CreateCatalogMicaProduceDetailResponse_2.title: Mica Produce Details Response

status.description: The status of the operation indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the created record.

processedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The count of records that matched the operation criteria.

CreateCatalogMicaProduceDetailResponse_2.description: This schema represents the response structure for the successful operation of producing details via POST request.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource being sent to the client. In this case, it specifies that the response body contains JSON data.

x-processing-time.description: Represents the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
